provenance: Synthetic examples. The forwarded-invoice scenario is inspired by a reported failure; people, organizations and identifiers are replaced. Expected outputs are human-authored references, not observed model results.

bodies:
Hi Jordan, could you look into an outstanding payment from our club last year?
--- Forwarded message ---
From: Campus coordinator
--- Forwarded message ---
From: Cedar Catering
Your support request R-883 was updated. Our accounts team found an unpaid invoice INV-2047 from September last year. Please confirm its payment status with accounts before we proceed with the new order. We are happy to issue a tax invoice to the Student Activities Club with our ABN and bank details, with payment after your internal processing.

expected.overview: Cedar Catering reports that last year's invoice INV-2047 remains unpaid and wants its payment status confirmed before proceeding with a new order. It can issue a tax invoice to the Student Activities Club, with payment after internal processing.

actions.text: Check invoice INV-2047's payment status with accounts.

rubric: Lead with reported unpaid invoice and impact on new order.
Do not claim R-883 is an order number.
Tax invoice is an offer, not an agreed decision.
No invented amount, owner, deadline or completeness assumption.
Do not duplicate the payment-status action as a question.

rubric: Latest confirmation supersedes earlier unpaid report.

rubric: Do not invent a review task or clarification question.
